title: Concept: Express middleware stack in a response
description: A Node Express stack frame naming the router layer in a response gives every reader the same visibility the bank has internally: The frame names the framework, the router layer and the file that threw, which tells an attacker the server stack and how requests are dispatched, and it often sits next to absolute paths.
applicability: Router internals shorten the path from a probe to a working exploit and expose the file layout.
risk: A stack frame is server-side detail with no use to the caller.
